verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own custom Dashboards made of widgets that each visualize one or more datasets across multiple projects, and the plans include custom dashboards. That covers the core of building dashboards, but nothing in the pack shows sharing, a range of visualization types, or template variables. The Grafana integration is a separate product's capability and earns no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of dashboard sharing or permissions, documented rich visualization types (chart or widget variety), template variables or dashboard-level filters, and dashboards-as-code definitions.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Dashboards are made up of one or more widgets, and each widget visualizes one or more dataset.

Sentry's [Dashboards](https://sentry.io/orgredirect/organizations/:orgslug/dashboards/) provide you with a broad overview of your application’s health by allowing you to navigate through error and performance data across multiple projects.
